included: governed separation case creation and immutable lifecycle
mandatory downstream task and callback receipt orchestration
post-separation REHIRE eligibility and linked corrective lineage
non-destructive CORRECTION after a published separation
excluded: return from a leave of absence
destructive edits to published separation or employment history
scopeDecision.returnEligibilityMeaning: IAQ-011 RETURN_ELIGIBILITY means eligibility to create a new linked REHIRE or CORRECTION after a PUBLISHED separation. It never means return from an active-employment leave of absence.
scopeDecision.reservedFutureMeaning: General LEAVE and RETURN remain a separately governed employment-absence capability and require their own semantic disposition, persistence authority and packet.

aggregate.name: SeparationCase
immutabilityRules: PUBLISHED facts are immutable and cannot be cancelled or edited in place.
Reconcile records a forward-only inconsistency signal and never rewrites the published termination fact.
Resolution after publication creates a new linked REHIRE or CORRECTION assignment event.
Cancellation is rejected after any irreversible downstream receipt.

operationClassification.guard: validated immutable input, exact template revision and accepted approval evidence
admitted caller workload, tenant, audience, purpose, callback event identity, owner revision and payload digest
all mandatory tasks completed or approval-authorized waived, accepted approval evidence, maker not equal approval actor, fresh step-up evidence and exact CAS
admitted downstream caller, published case, monotonic owner revision and exact callback digest
DRAFT or TASKS_ACTIVE only, no irreversible callback and exact CAS

requirements: tenant, audience, purpose and digest binding

idempotencyAndConcurrency.requestBinding: SHA-256 of canonical method, path, target, relevant headers, schema version and normalized body
idempotencyAndConcurrency.cas: Every case or task mutation requires exact expectedVersion; the public command also requires If-Match.
idempotencyAndConcurrency.callbackReplay: same identity and digest is a no-op replay; any digest conflict is rejected and quarantined
idempotencyAndConcurrency.guardOrder: Reject spoofed tenant, caller, audience, purpose, stale revision, out-of-order revision or digest mismatch before business-row reads.

atomicWriteSet: effective TERMINATION assignment event and relationship or assignment lineage
publicationBoundary.republishRule: A linked REHIRE or CORRECTION never republishes WorkerSeparated.v1 for the original separation version.

acceptanceConditions.criterion: IAQ-011 exact query state, cursor, field-decision, action allowlist and post-separation RETURN_ELIGIBILITY semantics.
PEP-HRM-013 create uses the exact method, paths, schema, capability and trusted tenant context.
Caller-supplied tenant, duty, population, field policy, purpose or internal transition route is rejected or absent.
Same-key same-hash replay returns the original receipt and same-key different-hash returns 409 without mutation.
Stale If-Match or expectedVersion fails exact CAS before any aggregate, receipt-success, audit-success or outbox-success write.
The six-state lifecycle and six transitions are exact; published facts cannot be edited or cancelled.
Spoofed, stale, out-of-order or digest-conflicting callbacks fail before business reads; exact replay is a no-op.
Mandatory tasks require COMPLETED or approval-authorized WAIVED with maker-checker and fresh-step-up evidence.
An irreversible downstream receipt blocks cancellation and requires linked corrective intent.
Publish atomically commits the case, termination lineage, receipt, audit pointer and XCON-028 outbox with the exact five-field no-PII payload.
Post-publication return or correction creates linked REHIRE or CORRECTION history without destructive mutation or duplicate WorkerSeparated publication.
After a separate active lease, V61 proves clean install, V60-to-V61 upgrade, RLS, terminal immutability and feature-OFF zero-call behavior.
